CastleParcel can be yours alone now. Set a password under Settings, Sign-in, and only you send files from your castle, plus the guests who know the upload password. It also tells you what happened and joins the fortress of your other apps. Recipients still open their links without signing in.

## ✨ Added

- **A sign-in for the owner.** Settings has a Sign-in tab: a password, a password check before sensitive changes, two-factor authentication, passkeys, sessions, API tokens and sign-in services over OpenID Connect such as Pocket ID, authentik or Authelia. Until you set a password CastleParcel stays open, exactly as before.
- **Your castle, your senders.** Once you have a password and no `UPLOAD_PASSWORD` is set, a stranger meets the sign-in instead of the castle. With `UPLOAD_PASSWORD`, guests still send with it, and the signed-in owner never needs it. Share links and file requests work as they always did.
- **A sign-in page with little on it.** One button signs you in, a second one appears for a sign-in service once you set one up, and Forgot password? is a quiet link that takes a code from the container log. Your browser offers a passkey right in the password field. Sign out sits next to Settings while you are signed in.
- **Notifications.** Settings has a Notifications tab. CastleParcel tells ntfy, Gotify, Discord, Slack, Matrix, email, Apprise or any webhook when files arrive at a file request, when the store is almost full and when the password was reset through the container log. Each channel has a test button, and the channels stay sealed in `CONFIG_DIR`.
- **CastleParcel joins the fortress.** The Fortress tab sits right above Info: enter the twelve words, and the other apps of your household show up with their status, and you open them from here. CastleParcel reports its running uploads and a storage quota that is nearly used up to them. Showing or changing the phrase asks for your password first.
- **Dashboard labels.** Dashboards that read container labels list CastleParcel with its name, logo and description on their own. Put the address in the template's Dashboard Link field to make the entry a link.
- **The Info tab has a Version and a Components card.** The Version card shows CastleParcel with where its updates stand, and What's new, Check for updates and How to update. What's new opens the release notes in a window of the app.
- `CASTLEPARCEL_APP_KEY` can hold the key that seals the sign-in and the notification channels. Without it CastleParcel writes `app.key` into `CONFIG_DIR`. Passkeys and sign-in services need `BASE_URL`.

## 🎨 Design

- The link preview card a chat app shows for a share link uses the house typeface.
- Built on GlimStone 4.9.1.

## ⚡ Improved

- A share password of any length works. Under 8 characters you get a hint, never a refusal.
- The database counts its versions, so a database from a later CastleParcel stops an older one at the start instead of being misread.

## 🌐 Translations

- The sign-in, the notifications and the fortress speak all 42 languages.

## 🔒 Security

- The sign-in is the shared one of the sibling apps (ParleyPort 1.3.4): Argon2id passwords, sessions that end on a password change, a reset code in the container log, PKCE and a nonce for sign-in services.
- While CastleParcel has no owner password and `UPLOAD_PASSWORD` is set, that password also guards the Sign-in, Notifications and Fortress tabs, so nobody who couldn't send files can make themselves the owner.
- A file request closes when the account that opened it is blocked, removed or reset, so nobody keeps uploading in that account's name. Share links stay with their recipients.
- Passkeys are allowed on the page itself. Every other browser feature the page never uses stays switched off, and the Content-Security-Policy is unchanged.
